verdict.rationale: Gram logs and stores tool-call records, so controlling how long that data is kept and deleting it is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents retention periods, retention settings, or deletion of logs or data. Related features such as exportable audit records and configuring telemetry delivery are adjacent and do not show retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
